title: P1 obs.query: request
description: Closed query of observation rollups by a job worker: a series only from the observes of its task type, within the task mark; the worker has no store credentials. Denials: fenced, type_not_allowed. The lease token is not passed in the body: the holder sends it in the Botaru-Lease header (spec/bindings/http/README.md), one way for all operations under a lease (FEN-2).
